business_problem: ADT wanted to connect HR data and AI so it could improve talent and compensation decisions, answer employee questions faster, and automate repetitive recruiting and performance-management work while keeping strong governance over workforce data.
solution_summary: ADT connected Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM, Oracle Fusion HCM Analytics, Oracle Fusion Agentic Applications, Oracle HR Help Desk, and Oracle Recruiting into one HR data foundation. Workforce transactions, help-desk inquiries, performance check-ins, goal updates, and employee self-service activity are analyzed in Oracle Fusion HCM Analytics so leaders can spot attrition risk, skills gaps, manager effectiveness, and other patterns by location, role, tenure, and team. Oracle's AI and agentic features then surface those insights inside self-service, onboarding, recruiting, and performance-management workflows, helping the company resolve inquiries automatically, guide new hires, draft reviews and goals, and automate recruiting actions. ADT also operates the environment inside Oracle's secure framework with named AI-agent owners, change-management governance, and human oversight for talent decisions, giving the company a governed path to scale workforce AI rather than isolated point solutions.
products_used: Oracle Fusion Cloud Human Capital Management (HCM)

solution_components.name: Oracle Fusion Cloud Human Capital Management (HCM)
solution_components.role: Provides ADT's core workforce, self-service, and onboarding data foundation.

solution_components.name: Oracle Fusion HCM Analytics
solution_components.role: Analyzes workforce patterns such as attrition, performance, manager effectiveness, and skills gaps.

solution_components.name: Oracle Fusion Agentic Applications
solution_components.role: Adds agentic AI capabilities for proactive insight surfacing and workflow orchestration across HR processes.

solution_components.name: Oracle HR Help Desk
solution_components.role: Supports employee inquiry resolution and self-service automation within the shared HR environment.

solution_components.name: Oracle Recruiting
solution_components.role: Automates high-volume recruiting workflows and uses AI to accelerate hiring and reduce attrition in key roles.

data_flow: HR transactions, help-desk tickets, performance check-ins, goals, and self-service activity flow into Oracle Fusion HCM and HCM Analytics, where dashboards and AI models identify patterns such as flight risk and skills gaps; those insights feed self-service, onboarding, review writing, and recruiting workflows through Oracle Fusion Agentic Applications, Oracle HR Help Desk, and Oracle Recruiting.
business_outcome: ADT improved the employee experience and HR efficiency by resolving most basic HR questions automatically, making turnover prediction and workforce planning more proactive, accelerating recruiting, and governing AI use centrally so the company can expand HR automation safely.
